output.brief: The rise at store 14 is probably not yet proven to be real loss. The interim figures are estimates with about ±0.6 points of error per quarter, and about half of comparable two-quarter rises were not confirmed by the full year-end count. Store 14's full-count results have been flat (1.5–1.8%). Recorded shoplifting jumped chain-wide when a new incident app launched in April, and chain shrink stayed flat, so the incident counts are a reporting effect. Self-checkout is unlikely to be the cause: the lanes were offline from April to late June, yet shrink kept rising. The night-stocker tip was checked on CCTV and found to be ordinary bale runs. Confidence is moderate. Next: keep store 14 in the 7 December full count, do not drop it, and do not suspend anyone. Remove the self-checkout and guard plans from the immediate agenda. Compare the full-count result with the interim figures before any store-specific action.
